summary: Acceptance requires nested error.code/error.message across WebSocket events and a read-only superadmin catalogue.

Replaced lossy realtime RuntimeDeviceError-to-None conversion so tenant-unbound, disabled, expired, duplicate, and unregistered devices emit their canonical nested WebSocket error. Targeted Docker Django suite: 16 tests passed; Docker frontend build passed. GitNexus reports broad expected cross-layer scope (33 affected flows) from the uncommitted catalogue migration; focused review found no blocking issue.

Superuser catalogue regression now checks all 35 static definitions: exact list count/cardinality and all UI-visible fields, plus exact numeric detail payloads for every code. Docker Django test apps.error_codes.tests.test_api: 4 tests passed. Docker frontend production build passed. Interactive browser smoke test remains unavailable because the bundled Chromium lacks libatk-1.0.so.0.
